task: Design exactly TWO 16:9 slides for the Agentic AI Hackathon Iraq, round 2, topic 04 'Bill Pay & Transfer Agent'. Slide 1 = our approach (the user, the system end to end, models/tools/data). Slide 2 = how we prove it works (testing, what could go wrong, what we would cut). Use ONLY the content below. Never invent numbers, quotes, users or results. Any value written as PENDING must be shown as «—».

deliverable.language: English; Arabic phrases stay in Arabic script, right-to-left

judged_on: awareness of what could go wrong

design_system.mood: Premium Iraqi fintech: calm, trustworthy, precise. Think a banking app's design system, not a school poster.

palette.primary: #174F43 deep green (titles, key numbers, step circles)
palette.accent: #D7ECAA lime (highlights, the 'full system' column, stat tiles)

design_system.typography: Arial or Segoe UI for Latin and Arabic. Title 28-32 pt bold, section headers 13-14 pt bold green, body 10-11 pt, captions 8-9 pt muted. Left-align body text.
design_system.motif: Numbered green circles and rounded cards (radius ~8 px) used consistently on both slides. One idea per card.
avoid: decorative stripes or underlines under titles
design_system.footer: 8 pt muted, both slides: Sources: Global Findex 2025 · Zain Annual Report 2025 · Medhi et al. (low-literacy mobile banking) · NADI 2025 Arabic ASR · UK Confirmation of Payee

slide_1.title: بكلمة — One sentence to pay a bill or send money
slide_1.tagline: The model reads. The code pays.
slide_1.layout: Top: title + tagline. Middle (hero): a 7-step horizontal journey of rounded cards with numbered circles; steps 1-2 on lime cards, steps 3-7 on soft green cards, with a small label under the row: 'Steps 1-2: the model, no wallet access · Steps 3-7: plain code touches the money'. Bottom-left card: Who we design for. Bottom-right card: Models, tools, data, beside a small phone-style mock of the confirmation card. Bottom row: four dark-green pill badges (differentiators).
journey_7_steps: Only who / what / how much as JSON; every span must be in the user's own words
Contacts, billers, Iraqi amounts; two Ahmeds or «كهرباء» = one question, never a guess
Balance + 250 IQD fee, daily limit, unpaid bill amount
Full name + masked phone, amount in digits AND words, fee, balance after, 120 s expiry
Button or exact «أكد» only; a spoken «أكد» never pays
Idempotency key = draft ID; lost reply → same key → «انخصم مرة وحدة بس»

confirmation_card_mock.style: Small phone-screen card, right-to-left, white with a green border

who_we_design_for: Wallet users who find multi-screen flows hard: older relatives, people who read little, people who ask family to 'do the app'.
Iraq: under 20% of adults hold a bank account; ZainCash alone has 1.2M+ users and 10,000 agents; cash is still the default.
Evidence: low-literacy users completed a mobile payment 0% of the time by text, 72% by spoken dialog, 100% by graphical UI. So: speak or type, see a card, tap.
Iraqi specifics: the neighbourhood generator (مولدة) is a biller; «كهرباء» = grid or generator; amounts like «ميت ألف», «ربع مليون».

models_tools_data.Understanding: Local LLM qwen3.5:4b via Ollama on a laptop: no customer text leaves the device. JSON-schema output; rule parser as fallback; the UI badge shows which one answered. A hosted model is a config switch.
models_tools_data.Execution: Plain code: FastAPI + SQLite mock wallet API. Atomic debit + ledger; (user, key) uniqueness for idempotency.
models_tools_data.Voice (stretch): Whisper; transcript always shown; uncertain names or amounts must be typed.
models_tools_data.Data: Wallet generated by the LLM from our schema: 5 users × 24 contacts (two «أحمد», «حسن»/«حسين», «خالو»), 7 billers incl. مولدة, 4 months of bills. 64 LLM-generated Iraqi-dialect requests (labels rule-checked; native-speaker edit next) + a 68-case development set.

differentiator_badges: The model has zero wallet tools

slide_2.corner_label: Slide 2 · How we prove it works
slide_2.title: Proven safe, measured honestly
slide_2.subtitle: Testing, what could go wrong, and what we would cut
slide_2.layout: Top: a row of four large stat tiles (lime numbers on deep-green tiles). Middle: the results table, full width. Bottom: three cards side by side: How we test (soft green) · What could go wrong → what we do (risk card) · If time runs short (soft green).

stat_tiles.label: wrong payments in every evaluation run
development requests handled by the full system
live demo flows pass on the LLM-generated wallet

results_table.title: Prototype results · local laptop, no cloud · each case run 3× on a fresh database
columns: LLM + span checks + rule fallback, as deployed
rows: Held-out after fixing what it revealed
results_table.styling: Header row on lime. Numbers bold. The 'Full system' column lightly highlighted. The 'Wrong payments' column in bold green.
results_table.caption: On 64 unseen requests the agent never guesses: when unsure it asks or refuses, so every miss is safe. The blind run exposed real gaps (Arabic لـ+ال contraction, unknown verbs, companies addressed with «دز»); general fixes lifted success while wrong payments stayed at 0.

how_we_test: Metrics in order: wrong payments (target 0, gates everything) → task success → correct questions vs over-asking → latency.
Held-out wallet + 64 requests generated by the LLM and frozen before tuning.
Fault injection: reply lost after the debit, crash before commit, biller down, 50 concurrent retries.
Next: native-speaker review of every request; 3-5 think-aloud sessions on the confirmation card.
risks_to_mitigations: Ask, with masked phones. Never guess.
LLM misreads, invents or drops a name or amount
Span checks reject it; the rules or a question take over.
Same idempotency key; the receipt says it was charged once.
Iraqi-dialect speech errors (best multi-dialect Arabic WER ≈ 36%)
Show the transcript; voice can never confirm.
Ignored. Confirmation lives in code, not the prompt.
Local model slow on CPU (~10 s)
Rule fallback; a hosted model is a config switch.

cut_list.never_cut: Confirmation card · ambiguity questions · idempotent execution · held-out evaluation

tone: Confident and precise. Lead with what is proven (0 wrong payments, 68/68, 4/4, 256/256); present held-out misses as safe questions, not failures. Never overstate.
final_checks: Every number exactly as written; PENDING shown as «—»; no new statistics.
Arabic correct and right-to-left, not machine-translated.
No text overflows its card; nothing under 8 pt.
No claim of real-user interviews or native-speaker approval unless the participant adds them.
